description: Use this when you need a raw read on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) without running a node: one read-only JSON-RPC call. Allowed: eth_blockNumber, eth_chainId, eth_gasPrice, eth_getBalance, eth_getCode, eth_getTransactionCount, eth_getStorageAt, eth_call, eth_estimateGas, eth_getTransactionByHash, eth_getTransactionReceipt, eth_getBlockByNumber and eth_getBlockByHash (headers), eth_getLogs (10,000 blocks, 500 logs at most). Returns the node answer as is.

params.description: its JSON-RPC params, as the node expects them

quote.description: true: return the price of this call without running or paying for it

name: robinhood_rpc
title: robinhood rpc
